description:
LLM chat completion: send messages and max_tokens, get the reply. Cheap Llama 3.1 8B chat completion over x402: send a prompt, pay USDC on Base, get the model reply. Returns: an OpenAI-style chat completion from the model the service is named for (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, Qwen3-32B or Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct): POST {messages: [{role, content}], max_tokens <= 1024}; returns the assistant message, the model, and its token usage. Messages up to 16,000 characters in total.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_bazaar_token_verdict_v2/llama3_1_8b_chat. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
